content: Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) and Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) are conditions that can lead to significant liver damage. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends cost-effective screening methods for these conditions. When FIB-7 index scores exceed 2.67, it is considered a strong indicator of a high likelihood of advanced liver fibrosis.
